data.narrative:
TurbineOne is a Series B-stage defense and security company founded by Ian Kalin and Matt Amacker, currently valued at $300M post-money on $58M total raised. The valuation analysis draws from a comparable universe of 10 companies—2 public (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private firms—all operating in the Defense & Security sector at equivalent stages, including Dream Security, Harmattan AI, Code Metal, Castelion, and Defense Unicorns.

Two triangulation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis, anchoring to the $300M last post-money valuation and applying a typical 1.9x step-up multiplier from Series B to the subsequent round, implies $570M. Peer-median analysis across the 6 same-sector, same-stage comparables yielded a median valuation of $1.1B, with a range of $1.0B to $3.0B. The peer set reflects meaningful dispersion, with Dream Security at the high end ($3.0B) and multiple peers clustered at the $1.0B floor.

The triangulated analysis supports a valuation range of $484M (low) to $1.3B (high), with a median of $848M. This range reflects tension between stage-progression methodology, which yields conservative results relative to peer medians, and peer comparables, which suggest material upside from the current $300M valuation. Key uncertainties include TurbineOne's relative product maturity and revenue traction versus the peer cohort, and whether the wide $1.0B–$3.0B peer dispersion reflects genuine comparability or heterogeneous business models within the Defense & Security category.
